name: hsm_smvm_wrq_t_r5
purpose: H-WRQ 2026-10-17: hardened SM result -> VM writer smw_<q> (one master, 4 instances), LANE-ROOT successor of faces4: one clock root per SM lane (pin flops + DEPTH-4 FIFO + server + wq launch flops + descriptor copy, ~1.7k sinks), core root = calendar/N-face host pins (~1.1k), clk_cal = table SRAM. No wide path crosses clock entries (faces4/f4hc: 13.7k cross-entry hold endpoints, ~32k hold buffers, TT -46.5 rp->o_w at the 210 ps inter-entry reserve). 0 edges added: rv(t) -> wq slot 0 at t+3, calendar fire edge unchanged.

pin_regs.reason: every input lands in a source pin flop (lane k: rv/rrow/rdata/smf/sms on clk_l<k>; core: F20 bus in the folded collar, tgt/quad strap flops, rst_n local reset-release flop) and every output is a source flop (lane k wq_s<k>: o_v/o_sec/o_m and 8 kept o_wr copies, one per replicated data pin; collar configured/fault/active)

structural_change: Clock partition by SM lane instead of by face (results/rtl/hsm_wrq_1017/DESIGN_NOTE.md): clk_l0..7 + clk + clk_cal replace clk/clk_in_lo/hi/clk_out_lo/hi/clk_hcfg/clk_cal; per-SM ports (rv_s/rrow_s/rdata_s/smf_s/sms_s/wq_s<k>); recipe 4 hold_budget die. Outline unchanged (pin-cut rule: W >= 344 um, E >= 360 um).
